title: eriogonum umbellatum var. hypoleium
intro: Eriogonum umbellatum var. hypoleium, commonly known as Sulfur Buckwheat, is a plant species in the buckwheat family (Polygonaceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and soothing skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Sulfur Buckwheat include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
